title: PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI
summary: Turns on automatic generation of a deformable body's simulation and collision meshes from a cooking source mesh, read on the prim carrying OmniPhysicsDeformableBodyAPI when PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI is listed in its usd-schemas. It also gates the PhysxAutoDeformableMeshSimplificationAPI and PhysxAutoDeformableHexahedralMeshAPI reads, and an explicit request to auto-cook the body requires it.
producer_scope: Published like any applied physics API: every declared attribute at its resolved value, the relationship only when authored. No column is rewritten or created by the producer.

columns.name: physxDeformableBody:autoDeformableBodyEnabled
columns.absent: false: no automatic generation. Body creation does not cook, so the simulation and collision mesh data already on the stage is used, and an explicit auto-cook request logs 'expected auto configuration'. USD's fallback is true, so write the value.
columns.notes: A change resyncs the deformable body and is one of the cooker's recook triggers.

columns.name: physxDeformableBody:cookingSourceMesh
columns.absent: No cooking source: with generation on, the cook warns 'deformable has no valid source mesh for cooking' and produces nothing. Only the first target is used and it must be a Mesh; its bind pose is the OmniPhysicsDeformablePoseAPI instance whose purpose is bindPose.

interactions.rule: Read only on a prim enumerated by OmniPhysicsDeformableBodyAPI that the ovstage walker accepts as a deformable body: a Mesh, TetMesh or BasisCurves, or an Xformable that is not a Gprim, with exactly one simulation mesh (OmniPhysicsVolumeDeformableSimAPI or OmniPhysicsSurfaceDeformableSimAPI) on the prim itself or an immediate child.
Its columns are read only when this API is listed too.
Its column is read only when this API is listed too, and only for a volume body.

notes: Cooking also reads and writes physxDeformableBody:deformableBodyDataCrc on the body prim, and attachment generation reads it; it is a runtime bookkeeping attribute that no schema declares and is not described here.
